Enum Class NetworkType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<NetworkType>
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.peering.enums.NetworkType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<NetworkType>, Constable
public enum NetworkType extends Enum<NetworkType>
Network type classification from PeeringDB's info_type field.

The type of network affects peering dynamics and the nature of connectivity:

  • NSP — Network Service Provider (transit). Peering provides route table access.
  • CONTENT — Content delivery (Netflix, Google). Peering receives their content.
  • ENTERPRISE — Enterprise network. Enterprise-to-enterprise peering is uncommon.
  • CABLE_DSL_ISP — Access ISP. Peering offloads eyeball traffic.
  • EDUCATION — Academic/research network (e.g., Internet2).
  • NON_PROFIT — Non-profit organization network.
  • ROUTE_SERVER — IX route server (e.g., Equinix MLPE RS).
  • GOV — Government network.

ianjones
